The full enumerator generates all ternary adjacent-unequal words exactly once for every 13<=n<=30, and uses only the published necessary parity lemma for pruning; then exact arithmetic, one-cycle traversal and counts give each c_n. value.rationale: The conjecture in Kumallagov asks for exactly this run-sharpness phenomenon. The eighteen-length ordered ternary optimizer counts are natural exact extremal invariants beyond the original table, and their nonuniformity and n=14 rigidity supply concrete structural benchmarks. Extending sharpness across the fifteen numerically unresolved lengths 14–27 and 30 is a motivated nontrivial finite cutoff, not an arbitrary invariant. No false claim of a general theorem or independent certification is made.
